attributes.title: 2027 Music City Veterinary Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Music City Veterinary Conference runs February 26 to 28, 2027, at the Embassy Suites hotel and conference center in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. The Tennessee VMA advertises more than 20 CE hours plus an exhibit hall, and the event is aimed at veterinarians, veterinary technicians, students and practice staff.

Technicians have their own registration rates: a full pass is $265 for TVMA members and $315 for non-members before February 6, 2027, rising by $50 afterwards; single-day passes are also offered. The conference hotel block is $162 per night until February 5, 2027.

The official page does not yet name a RACE program number or a per-attendee CE maximum, so check the session schedule and your state board's rules before counting hours.
